text: だれでも　おきにいりの　ポケモンを　とりに　いく　ばしょが　あるだろ！

structure.jp: おきにいりの　ポケモンを　とりに　いく　ばしょが
structure.en: a place they go to catch favorite Pokémon

patterns.name: 〜に (purpose)
patterns.explanation: A verb stem plus に before a verb of coming or going tells you what you go to do. とりに　いく = 'go to catch'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: とりに　いく　ばしょ
patterns.explanation: The phrase before ばしょ tells you what kind of place it is. ポケモンを　とりに　いく　ばしょ = 'a place you go to catch Pokémon'.

patterns.name: 〜だろう
patterns.explanation: だろう at the end asks the listener to agree, like 'right?'; だろ is the clipped, rougher form. あるだろ = 'there is one, right?'.
